First pre-release of augeo: measurable, reversible gaming performance and latency tweaks for Windows with NVIDIA GPUs.

**This is an early build, tested on one PC.** It changes Windows and NVIDIA driver settings. Read the [disclaimer](https://github.com/0xalperen/augeo#disclaimer) and start with level 0 and 1 tweaks.

## Download

- **`augeo-v0.1.0-windows-x64.zip`:** augeo plus PresentMon, needed for benchmarking
- **`augeo.exe`:** on its own, if you don't need benchmarks

There's nothing to install. Check downloads against `SHA256SUMS.txt`. The exe isn't code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen will warn you, and antivirus tools may flag it because it changes system settings.

## What's included

- 26 tweaks across 10 components, each with its evidence, sources, risks and danger level
- Exact-value undo, a crash-safe journal, and state read live from the system
- A read-only system check, and a Myths screen listing what augeo deliberately doesn't do
- Benchmarking with PresentMon: noise floor, per-tweak A/B tests and run history
- Timer tool and mouse polling meter

## What hasn't been tested

Ten tweaks were applied and undone on a real PC: Windows 11 26100, Ryzen 5 7600X, RTX 4070 SUPER. Still untested:

- **Benchmarks in real games.** So no performance gains are claimed yet.
- The higher-risk tweaks `cpu#1`, `cpu#2`, `network#1` and `system#4`, and per-game tweaks
- A real power cut during a change. Interruptions are tested by failing at every system call, and by killing a real process at random moments
- Intel hybrid CPUs, AMD X3D CPUs, laptops and Optimus, real Windows 10, and non-English Windows
- Antivirus results

`gpu#5` shows GPU scheduling as Windows reports it, through a query Microsoft marks as reserved for system use. It has only been seen with scheduling on. If the query stops working, augeo goes by the registry value instead.

Bug reports and measurements are welcome, including ones that show a tweak doesn't help.
